goal: Masken-Baukasten in zwei Schritten begründen: Schritt 1 Modell/Validierung/ApplicationPlan, Schritt 2 atomarer Vorlagenspeicher mit Versions- und Korruptionsschutz

guide_delta.summary: I88 liefert das unabhängige Vorlagenmodell plus atomaren JSON-Store. Vorlagen bleiben von autoritativen Datenbankwrites getrennt und können sicher validiert, gespeichert und geladen werden.

tests_required: step 1 model gate remains accepted without rerun because model.py and test_model.py are unchanged
compile package init store and focused store test
atomic template JSON roundtrip and sorted listing
existing templates require explicit expected version
updates require monotonic version and reject stale writers
invalid update leaves last valid template unchanged
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because I88 is an isolated new module
step 1 model test is not rerun because its relevant code is unchanged after a green intermediate gate
database tests because no database read or write path changes
TUI/Web runtime tests because no existing runtime is changed
visual tests because Drag and Drop UI starts only after the foundation is frozen
risks: template JSON storage is local filesystem state and not yet exposed through a user-facing editor
real database writes remain deliberately outside I88
future UI must not bypass model or store validation contracts
non_changes: no writer lifecycle or direct SQL writes
expected_side_effects: mask templates are deterministic validated values independent of storage and UI
validated templates can be atomically saved loaded listed and version-conflict checked
template application can be previewed as a plan without touching authoritative data
